changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Create finances.wallet_daily_snapshots, the end-of-day wallet value history the per-wallet dashboard charts against (issue #174). Figures are stored in the wallet's own currency, never converted, so a row stays reproducible regardless of how rates moved after it was written.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE finances.wallet_daily_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE, wallet_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES finances.wallets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, snapshot_date DATE NOT NULL, current_value NUMERIC NOT NULL, total_invested NUMERIC NOT NULL, gain NUMERIC NOT NULL, gain_pct NUMERIC NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (wallet_id, snapshot_date) );
